method: Traverse elaborated declaration types and (optionally) values, including opaque bodies; expand constructors of reached ReasLib inductive/structure types to retain field specifications. Module ownership uses Environment.getModuleIdxFor?. Counts include generated declarations and describe these elaborated terms, not an absolute mathematical minimum or a deletable-file set.
proof_policy: Skip bodies of proposition-valued declarations while retaining their types. Inline proof references in retained data bodies remain.
